component_spec.part_family: 5 mm red LED with series resistor

quantities_taught.child_facing_meaning: how much electricity is squeezing through the wire each second

sequence: seat both leads before the module is switched on
switch the module off before any lead is moved

calculations.margin_to_rating: 13.6 mA against an absolute maximum of 30 mA, a 55 percent margin

behaviour.child_level: The light only comes on one way round, and the resistor keeps it from burning out.
behaviour.adult_level: The LED is a diode with an exponential I-V characteristic above its forward threshold; the series resistor sets the operating current because the diode itself does not limit it.
behaviour.simplification_check: The child version omits the exponential curve, which stays honest because the resistor makes the operating point insensitive to it.

ratings_and_limits.source: Kingbright WP7113ID datasheet rev 8, absolute maximum ratings
Kingbright WP7113ID datasheet rev 8, absolute maximum ratings

failure_modes.wrong_action: connecting the LED without the series resistor
failure_modes.consequence: forward current runs far past 30 mA and the die is destroyed in under a second
failure_modes.prevented_by: the resistor is placed and checked before the module is switched on

failure_modes.wrong_action: seating the LED with its leads reversed
failure_modes.consequence: no light, and the reverse voltage rating of 5 V is approached
failure_modes.prevented_by: the long lead is identified against the printed map before seating

build_map.orientation: Board laid long side towards the child, rail markings uppermost, column 1 at the left.

components_placed.orientation: spanning the centre trench, f5 to f8
long lead in e9, short lead in e12

placement_steps: Seat the resistor across the centre trench from f5 to f8.
Seat the LED with its long lead in e9 and its short lead in e12.
Run the red wire from the top rail at column 3 to e5.
Run the black wire from e12 to the bottom rail at column 12.

safety_inset.shows: The resistor is in the path before the LED, and the module stays off until an adult has checked both leads.

power_profile.source: breadboard power-supply module fed from the 9 V battery
power_profile.polarity: fixed by the module output block, verified before switch-on
